newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page- May 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page- May 13.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page on Tuesday:
* The Army buddy of accused Oklahoma City bomber Timothy McVeigh testified that McVeigh planned to blow up the federal building "to cause a general uprising in America."

* The White House filed an appeal with the U.S. Supreme Court, seeking to reverse a ruling that said notes taken by White House lawyers in meetings with first lady Hillary Rodham Clinton were not protected by lawyer-client privilage.
* New York Gov. George Pataki proposed eliminating rent protections on apartments once they become vacant.
* An expedition of mountain climbers was feared dead on Mount Everest.

* The editor of the San Jose (Calif.) Mercury News said that a series of articles on the increase in crack cocaine in urban America, which prompted a number of federal investigations, was marred by shortcomings.
* The rising price of coffee on the futures market is trickling down to the retail arena, making for pricier cups of coffee.
* Decades of decay in Zaire is causing bottlenecks and making it more difficult for refugees to return.
